newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Bond confirms Southam ratings.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bond confirms Southam ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday it confirmed the rating on Southam Inc's notes at BBB (high) with a stable trend.
DBRS said it confirmed the rating on Southam commercial paper at R-1(Low) with a negative trend.
The agency cited Southam's higher earnings for the nine-month period ending September 30.
"Operating cash flows, however, remain insufficient to finance a plant modernization program and recent acquisitions," DBRS said.

"As a result, the balance sheet weakened somewhat, and interest coverage deteriorated slightly compared to the year ended 1995, although both ratios remain favorable. This trend is expected to continue until at least 1998, when the plant modernization program will be complete," the agency said.
DBRS said its analysis does not take into account the possibility of additional financial leverage should majority owner Hollinger Inc decide to boost its Southam stake.

"Southam has a number of challenges to overcome, including declining circulation related to demographics, a weak market in Montreal, as well as the underperformance of the Vancouver operations," the agency said.
"A new management culture introduced by controlling shareholder, Hollinger Inc, should be a positive influence in terms of the company's overall profitability," it added.
